input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone. It’s been happening for the past few hours, and I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?
Sure! My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information from me.
It looks like my messaging app currently cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next to get this fixed?
I’d prefer to refuel additional data rather than change my plan. Could you please add 2.0 GB of data to my line so I can try sending MMS messages again?
Yes, please go ahead and add 2.0 GB of data to my line for $4.00. Let me know once it’s done so I can try sending an MMS again.
I just tried again, but unfortunately, I still can’t send MMS messages. Is there something else we can try to fix this?
At the moment, my status bar shows that Airplane Mode is turned on, and my battery is at 80%. I don’t see any network signal or mobile data icons. What should I do next?

I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now, my status bar shows “No Signal” and “Data Disabled,” and the battery is still at 80%. I don’t see any network signal or mobile data icons yet. What should I do next?
I’ve turned mobile data on, but my status bar still shows “No Signal” and “Data Disabled.” There’s no improvement in signal strength. What should I try next?
The SIM card status check says that no SIM card is detected in the phone. What should I do now?
I removed and reinserted the SIM card. Now, my phone shows a poor signal with 2G, data is enabled, and the SIM card status says it’s active and working. What should I do next?
I’ve changed the network mode preference to “4G/5G preferred.” Now, my status bar shows an excellent signal with 5G, and data is enabled. What should I do next?
I just tried sending an MMS again, but it still isn’t working. I’m still unable to send MMS messages. What else can we try?

I checked my APN settings, and it looks like the MMSC URL for picture messages is not set. Would you like to guide me through setting it up, or should I reset the APN settings to default as you suggested?
I’ve reset the APN settings as you suggested. Should I go ahead and reboot my device now to apply the changes?
I’ve rebooted my device and tried sending an MMS again, but unfortunately, it still isn’t working. I’m still unable to send MMS messages. What should we try next?
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned on. Would you like me to turn it off and then try sending an MMS again?
I turned off Wi-Fi Calling and tried sending an MMS again, but I still can’t send MMS messages. What else can we try?
